title: Finance Automation & Cash Visibility
summary: Digitized financial controls, cash flow planning, receivables tracking, and shared expense allocations — turning fragmented manual finance operations into automated, auditable workflows with real-time management visibility.

projectItems.title: Finance & Purchase Order Workflow Automation
projectItems.summary: Automated invoicing, purchase approvals, and expense workflows with multi-level approval triggers, automated task assignments, and real-time status tracking across business entities.
projectItems.problemStatement: Finance processes relied heavily on manual data entry from sales orders into invoices. Purchase approvals took days because emails got buried without audit trails, and month-end reconciliation was inconsistent across business entities.
projectItems.solution: Built Zoho Creator applications linked with Zoho Books to automate invoice creation upon CRM sales order approval. Designed a digital procurement workflow requiring multi-tier management sign-offs and automated task assignments with SLA countdowns.
projectItems.impact: Eliminated manual invoice creation errors, streamlined procurement approvals, and provided leadership with a real-time dashboard of pending approvals and financial task bottlenecks.
projectItems.keyTakeaway: Replaces manual paper/email finance approvals with structured system checks, saving administrative time and creating an auditable financial trail.

projectItems.title: Automated Receivables & Ageing Tracking
projectItems.summary: Integrated CRM and Books receivables module with scheduled sync, 30/60/90/120-day ageing categorization, automated collection reminders, and owner-assigned follow-up tasks.
projectItems.problemStatement: Payment collection follow-ups were reactive and manual. Ageing reports were compiled once a month in Excel, leaving no clear accountability for overdue client invoices across sales and finance teams.
projectItems.solution: Configured automated daily synchronization between Zoho Books and CRM. Built automatic 30/60/90/120-day ageing bucketing, triggered automated follow-up tasks assigned to account owners, and created an executive collection dashboard.
projectItems.impact: Eliminated monthly manual Excel ageing preparation and established clear ownership for overdue invoices, improving cash collection discipline across accounts.
projectItems.keyTakeaway: Transforms payment collection from a reactive month-end exercise into an automated, daily operational follow-up system.

projectItems.title: Cash Flow Planning & Outflow Calendar
projectItems.summary: Built a custom cash-planning application in Zoho Creator featuring projected vs actual cash tracking, vendor payment scheduling calendar, date-change audit history, and multi-entity consolidation.
projectItems.problemStatement: Management had no single view of consolidated cash flow across business entities. Vendor payment scheduling was maintained in offline spreadsheets, and changes to payment dates had no audit log, making cash forecasting unreliable.
projectItems.solution: Engineered a Zoho Creator application with an interactive outflow payment calendar, mandatory reason logging for any payment date shifts, automated balance calculations, and API data sync from Zoho Books.
projectItems.impact: Gave the CFO and executive leadership a unified, real-time view of daily and weekly cash positions across entities, ensuring reliable vendor payment planning.
projectItems.keyTakeaway: Combines operational payment scheduling with automated accounting data to give leadership accurate, real-time liquidity visibility.

projectItems.title: Automated Corporate Expense Allocation
projectItems.summary: Created an automated headcount-ratio workflow for distributing shared corporate expenses across business verticals with automated P&L data fetch, manager approval routing, and direct journal posting.
projectItems.problemStatement: Shared monthly expense allocation took over 6 hours of manual spreadsheet work every month-end. Manually calculating headcount proportions and posting journal entries to multiple entities led to occasional formula errors and inconsistent methods.
projectItems.solution: Developed a custom Zoho Creator workflow that automatically pulls monthly P&L figures from Zoho Books, calculates allocations based on active headcount ratios, routes draft journals for manager sign-off, and posts approved entries back to Books via API.
projectItems.impact: Saved 6 hours per month of tedious manual accounting work while ensuring 100% mathematical accuracy and a clear audit trail for month-end financial reviews.
projectItems.keyTakeaway: Automates complex monthly accounting allocations, turning hours of error-prone spreadsheet work into a 5-minute validated approval process.

projectItems.title: Consolidated Finance Task Dashboard
projectItems.summary: Built a unified task dashboard aggregating accounting tasks and pending approvals across all business entities into a single Director-level operational matrix.
projectItems.problemStatement: The Finance Director had to check separate Zoho Books instances to review team workload and pending tasks across business entities, making it hard to catch overdue items or balance team work.
projectItems.solution: Created a centralized analytical view in Zoho Analytics aggregating task records across entities with priority indicators, overdue alerts, and team workload distribution charts.
projectItems.impact: Gave leadership full visibility into operational finance health and team bandwidth across all active entities.
projectItems.keyTakeaway: Consolidates multi-entity operational tasks into a single management dashboard for proactive workload oversight.
